mcq_drop.why: dubious: Black Sea layers rarely mix because of density (salinity) stratification, not 'chemical differences'; oddly worded

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: physical vs chemical change (chemistry); options garbled

patterns: Recurring single-fact items: highest salinity water body (Dead Sea / Red Sea among seas), main source of salinity (land), salinity gradient = halocline.
Water-distribution ranking (oceans > ice > groundwater > rivers; groundwater largest after ice) is asked repeatedly across PSCs incl. APPSC 2025.
Trap: maximum salinity in the subtropics/Tropic of Cancer belt, not at the equator; Arabian Sea saltier than Bay of Bengal.
APPSC also mixes in water-density science (maximum density at 4 C).
App uses long 4-5 statement lists of salt percentages and 2025 heat-record data; PYQs stay at direct one-fact level.
